verdict.rationale: ernd is an AI-spend business card with an app, and any SaaS product of this kind could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The first-party evidence covers only rewards, fees and card requests, with no mention of llms.txt or agent-facing documentation. The probes checked developers.google.com rather than ernd's own domain, so they say nothing about ernd either way.
